title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game

sents.t: Carlos remembers his promise.
On Sunday, he takes me to my first baseball game.
The Oakville Owls are playing the Riverside Rockets at Oakville Stadium.
The stadium is full of people.
Everyone wears the team colors, green and white.
Carlos buys me an Owls cap.
“Now you are a real fan!” he says.
Our seats are behind first base.
Carlos explains the rules.
“Each team has nine players. The pitcher throws the ball, and the batter tries to hit it. Then he runs to first, second, and third base, and home. That is a run.”
“OK. I think I understand,” I say.
But it is not easy!
Baseball games are long, almost three hours.
But I enjoy watching the people too.
They eat hot dogs and popcorn.
In the seventh inning, everyone stands up and sings “Take Me Out to the Ball Game.”
In the ninth inning, the score is 3 to 3.
Then an Owls player hits the ball very far.
Home run!
The Owls win, 5 to 3!
“So, do you like baseball now?” Carlos asks.
“I love it!” I say.
